name: xw-platform
description: XW Platform source monorepo. Root scripts forward into services; npm workspaces are not enabled.

scripts.check: npm --prefix services/orchestrator run check && npm --prefix services/control-plane run check && node --check tools/fusion/cli.mjs && node --check tools/fusion/verify.mjs && node --check tools/fusion/git.mjs && node --check tools/fusion/test-gate.mjs && node --check tools/fusion/accept.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:fusion && npm run test:gate
